mapper.select: SELECT emp_id, emp_name, gender, dept, post, salary, hire_date, status FROM emp ORDER BY emp_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO emp (emp_name, gender, dept, post, salary, hire_date, status) VALUES (#{empName}, #{gender}, #{dept}, #{post}, #{salary}, #{hireDate}, #{status})
mapper.update: UPDATE emp SET emp_name = #{empName}, gender = #{gender}, dept = #{dept}, post = #{post}, salary = #{salary}, hire_date = #{hireDate}, status = #{status} WHERE emp_id = #{empId}
